install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-b32895f4e754bb002df2，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-notify-win 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。原生 Windows toast + 任务栏闪烁，任务完成/审批/提问时触发，支持 Win10/11，npm 安装 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b32895f4e754bb002df2.html
posts.en:
dsh-notify-win is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for task done / approval / ask_user_question, Win10/11, npm install `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notify-win`.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b32895f4e754bb002df2.html
